Tasmā na kiñci etaṁ, Pāḷivaseneva ca paṭikkhittantipi na gahetabbaṁ.
Idameva pana gahetabbaṁ. Sekkhassāpi phalameva uppajjati, na maggo.
Phalañcassa sace anena paṭhamajjhāniko maggo adhigato hoti,
